custom_logic_notes: Gap trading strategy: places Buy Stop above highest high and Sell Stop below lowest low of last LookbackBars on Friday at 23:00-23:15 (configurable DayOfWeek/Hours/Minutes). Uses a session flag (ordersPlacedForThisSession) to prevent duplicate orders within the same session. Flag resets on Monday (day_of_week==1), and all pending orders are deleted on Monday reset. Stop Loss is set for buy-side orders only (price - StopLoss*_Point); sell-side orders have SL=0 implicitly. Take Profit is 0 for all pending orders; instead, open positions are closed when unrealized profit reaches SecureProfitTarget in USD. Pending order prices are adjusted to comply with SYMBOL_TRADE_STOPS_LEVEL minimum distance from current market price.
python_conversion_notes: The session flag logic (ordersPlacedForThisSession) must be replicated as state that persists across ticks but resets weekly. The CopyHigh/CopyLow lookback logic maps directly to pandas/numpy rolling max/min on OHLC data. Pending order management (place Buy Stop/Sell Stop, delete on Monday) requires an order state tracker. The margin check (OrderCalcMargin) has no direct Python equivalent — approximate with broker margin requirements or skip. The SYMBOL_TRADE_STOPS_LEVEL adjustment must be fetched from broker specs. No TP on orders means exit logic is purely the SecureProfitTarget check on open position PnL — implement as a monitoring loop. Note: SL is only calculated for buy-side order types (BUY_LIMIT, BUY_STOP); sell-side orders (SELL_STOP) have SL=0 which is a likely bug or intentional omission.
